quest.title: Perils in the Dark
quest.description: The strange crystal plummeted toward the ground and shattered it, revealing an entrance to even greater depths. Who knows what's down there... But either way, it would be best to proceed with caution.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x50, Mora x50000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Take the path that leads deeper in

dialogues.speaker: Fatuus' Journal
dialogues.text: "...Serzhant Anton has discovered a large bell to the southeast. The rock walls have "their" script all over it..."

dialogues.speaker: Fatuus' Journal
dialogues.text: "...This is very similar to the large bell that the Kapitan-Poruchik discovered in the ruins to the northwest. Perhaps..."

dialogues.speaker: Fatuus' Journal
dialogues.text: "...We dispatched Snezhevna and Fadeyka to ring the two bells in their respective corners..."

dialogues.speaker: Fatuus' Journal
dialogues.text: "...As the terrifying tolls reverberated through the stone, the black fog dissipated. What a strange phenomenon... it's almost like the bells were announcing someone's arrival..."

dialogues.speaker: Fatuus' Journal
dialogues.text: "...Ten were lost, two vanguard squads took immense damage. The Kapitan-Poruchik ordered a retreat..."

dialogues.speaker: Fatuus' Journal
dialogues.text: (A simple map falls out from the diary. The map marks out the two bells in the northwest and the southeast, with two ominous skulls to go with them.)

talks.objective: Examine the dark fog in front of you
Look for clues near the dark fog
Ring the two bells on either side of the ruins
